name: ModelVariant777_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant777_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (every period a jittered lightning bolt of up to twelve points grows from a model point towards the opposing slot. notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the French header-794 images build the same source through french_model_variant/variant794_entry.c with VERSION_FRENCH at the same addresses. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
